actions: assists elbow extension, stabilizes elbow (dynamically tensions the joint capsule)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Small triangular muscle continuous with triceps' medial head; active throughout elbow extension to protect the joint capsule from impingement.
